title: Read-only readiness consumes explicit local materials and degrades an exhausted scoped candidate to root-local unlocated
prompt: 只读完成证据化技术设计：先阅读需求文档、HTML 原型和示例图片，再检查已授权的 backend/frontend 源码。若 owner、数据契约、写入目标、测试入口或回滚边界任一未闭合则 blocked；不写代码，不得猜测具体接口、表、字段、状态或 owner。

workspace_files.requirements.md:
# Requirement
See [prototype](prototype.html) and example.png. Choose a slice only after all core dependencies are evidence-closed.

scripted_responses.content:
## Requirement facts
- requirements.md:1 links prototype.html and example.png and requires evidence-closed core dependencies before selection.
- prototype.html was read. example.png inspection is unavailable, so it is not visual evidence for this decision.

## Source facts
- backend/src/AnalogOwner.java:1 defines AnalogOwner for an adjacent flow only.

## Blocking dependencies
- The frontend root remains unlocated after its bounded candidate read exhausted; owner, data/source contract, write target, test entry, and rollback boundary remain unlocated.

## Design proposal
- Implementation readiness: blocked. No implementation slice is selected.

arguments.reason: The candidate distinguishes requirements, bounded source evidence, and the root-local unlocated boundary without inventing an implementation target.

implementation_readiness.reason: The frontend candidate read exhausted without a successful direct source read.

residual_risk: This fixture proves bounded material completion and root-local candidate-read degradation; live provider malformed envelopes and repository ranking remain independently gated.
